annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cabinet Office / Crown Commercial Service (UK Government)
key_provisions_or_claims: Suppliers' use of AI in bids is not prohibited but should be understood and risks managed.
Contracting authorities may ask suppliers to disclose AI use in tenders using example questions in Annex B.
Apply proportionate controls to stop confidential tender information being used as AI training data.
Undertake proportionate additional due diligence on AI-assisted tenders and plan for more time and volume.
Ask whether AI is used in delivering nominally non-AI services; consider national security mitigations.
named_instruments_referenced: A pro-innovation approach to AI regulation
annotation.summary_en: UK Procurement Policy Note 02/24 advises central government bodies on handling suppliers' use of AI in tenders and AI embedded in services. It recommends disclosure questions, due diligence, controls on confidential data used for AI training, and security engagement, without prohibiting supplier AI use.
annotation.title_clean: Transparency of AI use in Procurement - Information Note 02/24
